chapters.label: The save, live
chapters.text: Recife, the 2014 World Cup. Costa Rica against Greece, and it goes to penalties! Costa Rica lead four-three. Theofanis Gekas steps up. Keylor Navas bounces on his line... Gekas shoots. Navas flies to his right. Saved!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Navas stays on his toes. He pushes off hard, and reaches across with his left hand. Strong hand! The ball bounces away.

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: what a stop! Navas jumps up and roars. Next kick, Costa Rica score, and they reach the quarter-finals for the first time!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Keepers, stay on your toes. Watch the ball. Push off hard with your legs, and make a strong hand. Even a hard shot can't beat a strong hand!
